sampling_implementation.remeasure: retain all attempts; repeat complete sample set of CV-failing cohorts, at most three attempts in the same continuous session; never reject individual samples
sampling_implementation.scheduler: role pipelines within ordered paper blocks; separate live request each sample; common received bytes for mutually exclusive validation profiles

equal_budget_configuration.system_account: actual issuance both roles + actual cold parent openings + all delegation both roles; setup/keygen/public installation and first-use scope opening separate
equal_budget_configuration.codec_boundary: current formal issuance/request/response receiver segments parse actual sender bytes; delegation/public-package receive parsing is actual; each issuer-only ledger excludes counterpart roles

substage_scope.other_schemes: role/stage/cold-hot totals plus the mandatory independent strict received-decoding stage for all ten schemes
substage_scope.total_timing: one execution records total and consecutive intervals, only DARLT default k16 detailed; no component reruns

input_pool_policy.distinct_input: fresh complete request per sample; fixed native PP/keys/wallet/precomputed proofs may be reused
input_pool_policy.state: deep restore of bank/verifier snapshot before each verification step and sample
input_pool_policy.cross_sample_cache: fixed verification key and native precomputations only; no proof/token-specific intermediate or verdict

fixed_verification.rule: all acceptance pairing equations in one validation step checked together using SET; DARLT combines all native blocks in the same complete request; interactive schemes combine within each round only

coefficients.distribution: independent uniform nonzero 16-byte little-endian integers; rejection of all-zero bytes; inject into scalar field without modular reduction bias
coefficients.formal_random_source: StdRng seeded with 32 bytes from operating-system OsRng outside the timed boundary; coefficient extraction/rejection inside native validation
coefficients.clock_free_tests: deterministic cryptographic RNG seeds for reproducible correctness only
coefficients.native_protocol_randomness: signature, Sigma, FS challenge and prover randomness unchanged

fixed_verification.single_equation: one-equation steps may use exact native check, mathematically the same acceptance predicate with no pointless redundant exponent
fixed_verification.GT_transcript_values: pairing values defining native Sigma/FS transcript inputs or backend outputs are still computed exactly; they are not boolean acceptance equations to merge

formal_ready_pending: Configure an active sampling window before collecting retained samples.
